citation.note: Written advance notice of any wage, salary, payday, or policy change before the effective date, with signed employee acknowledgment retained in the personnel file (RSA 275:49).

Personnel and payroll records for employers with 15 or more employees retained at least 1 year, documenting name, address, occupation, hours, rate, gross and net pay, deductions, and leave accrual (RSA 275:56).
Wages paid at least weekly or biweekly within 8 or 15 days of the week worked; less frequent schedules only on written petition showing good cause, never less than monthly (RSA 275:43).
Discharge: all wages within 72 hours. Resignation with notice: next regular payday; without notice: within 72 hours of the last day worked; layoff: next regular payday (RSA 275:44).

body.deadline_description: Discharge: all wages within 72 hours. Resignation with notice: next regular payday; without notice: within 72 hours of the last day worked; layoff: next regular payday (RSA 275:44).

citation.note: Non-competes void for employees at or below 200% of the federal minimum wage (about $14.50/hour); physician non-competes void regardless of wage; pre-offer disclosure required (RSA 275:70-a, RSA 329:31-a, RSA 275:70).

body.rule: Non-competes void for employees at or below 200% of the federal minimum wage (about $14.50/hour); recalculate on promotion because crossing the threshold changes enforceability (RSA 275:70-a).

citation.note: Mirrors federal WARN: employers with 100 or more full-time employees give 60 days' advance written notice of plant closing or mass layoff affecting 25 or more employees or 25% or more of the workforce (RSA 275-F).

body.note: Federal WARN compliance: State-level notification requirement mirrors federal WARN Act for employers with 100+ employees planning mass layoffs or plant closings; 60 days' advance notice required (RSA 275-F).

citation.note: Sex-based equal pay for equal work requiring equal skill, effort, and responsibility; wage discussion protected and pay confidentiality may not be a condition of employment (RSA 275:37, RSA 275:41-b).
No state-mandated itemized pay stub format; federal FLSA requirements apply (employer should document hours, wage rate, deductions, net pay per RSA 275:56 record-retention obligation).
Employees may inspect and receive copies of their personnel file on written request; employers with 15 or more employees retain records 1 year (RSA 275:56).
Wage discussion protection (RSA 275:41-b): employees protected from retaliation for disclosing or discussing wages or benefits; pay confidentiality may not be required.

citation.note: No state law restricting private-sector drug testing.

Breach of computerized personal information: notify affected individuals as soon as possible and without unreasonable delay, plus the attorney general or primary regulator, when misuse is likely (RSA 359-C:20).
New Hampshire sets no state minimum above the federal $7.25/hour floor (RSA 279:21); federal overtime applies.
